name: Breakthrough
overview: Scripture reveals that breakthrough is a divine act where God makes a new way in seemingly impossible circumstances, as He promises in Isaiah 43:19 to create paths in the wilderness and rivers in the desert. This breakthrough is secured by God's protection and righteousness, ensuring that no weapon formed against His servants will prosper (Isaiah 54:17). Believers are called to remain steadfast in Christ's word (John 8:31) and empowered by the Holy Spirit to witness boldly (Acts 1:8), reflecting the spiritual breakthrough symbolized by the breaker who leads His people through barriers (Micah 2:13). God's plans for His people are filled with hope and purpose, promising an expected and hopeful future (Jeremiah 29:11).
